---
name: review-recorded-connector-carry-forward
description: "Review suspended connectors for an already recorded carry-forward approval within the authorized session scope, preserving suspension when no qualifying record is found."
---
## 适用条件
Use when asked to determine whether suspended connectors in a named batch already have a previously approved carry-forward subset on record. This is an evidence review, not authority to grant an exception or reactivate a connector.
## 排除条件
Does not establish new approval criteria, authorize writes, or infer approval from restart-candidate notes. Empty session search results do not prove approval never existed outside the searched scope. No positive-case mutation schema is established here.
## 操作步骤
1. List suspended integrations with config_list_integrations using status="suspended". Identify the requested batch from returned records and notes; retain the exact integration_id set and exclude unrelated connectors.
2. Read each target with config_get_integration using integration_id. Record status, exception_approved and notes; a pending review or restart-candidate note is not a recorded approval.
3. Search authorized session history with session_search using the batch name and carry-forward terminology, then each target integration_id individually. Do not rely solely on a combined-ID query returning no matches.
4. If records are found, inspect the original approval evidence for exact connector/subset scope and any date or version limits. Keep tool-return facts separate from later interpretation; do not invent missing dates or assume historical approval is currently valid.
5. If no qualifying approval is found, report that none is recorded in the searched session scope and retain all target connectors as blocked and suspended. Distinguish an empty successful search from a failed or unavailable search.
6. Keep the review read-only: issue no approval, activation or configuration writes. A positive historical match alone does not supply an action schema or authority to change status.
7. Follow the current output contract. When required, emit BATCH|approved_ids_or_none|blocked_ids using exact target IDs; for the confirmed no-record case use none and list every target as blocked.
## 验证
- Verify successful tool responses and their bodies, not merely HTTP status. Confirm the target inventory is complete and each reviewed target remains suspended.
- Ensure every reported approved ID has explicit supporting approval evidence; pending notes and empty searches are not approval evidence.
- For a no-record result, verify blocked_ids exactly equals the in-scope target set, with no omitted or unrelated IDs, and approved_ids_or_none is none.
- Confirm no write calls occurred, leaving target and excluded records unchanged; preserve uncertainty when session history could not be searched successfully.

---
name: apply-authorized-connector-restart-subset
description: "Apply an explicitly authorized session-bounded restart exception to an exact connector subset, using the requested fields and note while verifying blocked connectors remain unchanged."
---
## 适用条件
Use when the current instruction explicitly authorizes a session-bounded restart exception for enumerated integration IDs, specifies status=active and exception_approved=true, and supplies the required note and blocked subset.
## 排除条件
Not for read-only historical approval lookup or deciding eligibility. Candidate notes, shared batch membership and historical approvals alone do not authorize writes. Do not extend a session-bounded exception to other connectors or assume continuing validity beyond its authorized scope.
## 操作步骤
1. Extract the exact approved and blocked integration_id sets, batch scope, required note and output contract from the current instruction. Check that the sets are disjoint; do not select connectors merely because their notes match the batch.
2. Read every approved and blocked connector with config_get_integration(integration_id). Retain baseline status, exception_approved, notes and other returned fields for post-write comparison; resolve missing records or scope conflicts before writing.
3. For each authorized ID only, call config_update_integration with integration_id, status="active", exception_approved=true and notes equal to the exact instructed text. Do not send updates to blocked or unrelated IDs or alter unrelated fields.
4. Inspect each update response body for status="updated" and an integration object matching the requested integration_id, status, exception_approved and notes. An HTTP success alone is insufficient; do not report failed or unverified updates as approved.
5. Read every approved and blocked ID again using config_get_integration. Confirm authorized changes persisted and blocked records remain suspended with baseline exception_approved, notes and other fields unchanged.
6. Reconcile all write targets against the exact authorized set and check unrelated connector fields stayed unchanged, apart from service-managed update metadata. Retain session limits in the note; do not invent expiry fields or broader authorization.
7. Follow the current output contract. When BATCH|approved_ids|blocked_ids is required, use exact IDs and report success only after the requested subset changes and blocked-state checks are confirmed; disclose failures rather than claim full completion.
## 验证
- Every authorized ID has a successful update response and readback showing status="active", exception_approved=true and the exact required note.
- The actual write-target set equals the explicitly authorized subset, with no blocked or unrelated write targets.
- All blocked IDs have post-write reads confirming status="suspended" and unchanged baseline fields, including exception_approved and notes.
- Reported ID sets match the instruction and verified outcomes; neither batch membership nor pending-review notes are treated as authorization.

---
name: apply-authorized-connector-restart-subset
description: "Apply an explicitly authorized session-bounded restart exception to an exact connector subset, using requested fields and note while verifying blocked connectors remain unchanged."
---
## 适用条件
Use when the current instruction authorizes an exact session-bounded restart subset and supplies status, approval flag, note and blocked IDs, or explicitly directs the same narrow handling as an earlier settled decision recoverable from authorized session evidence.
## 排除条件
Not for read-only lookup or deciding eligibility. Batch notes, caches, memory and historical approval alone do not authorize writes. Do not extend the exception beyond its authorized scope. Resolve uncertainty before writing.
## 操作步骤
1. Extract exact approved and blocked integration_id sets, batch scope, required note and output contract from the current instruction. For delegated carry-forward, recover them from the original authorized session record; check the sets are disjoint.
2. Search session history using the batch and carry-forward terms, then target IDs individually if needed. Inspect original approval messages and tool returns; a combined-ID query alone is insufficient. Distinguish empty successful searches from unavailable searches.
3. Resolve subset, action fields and scope limits from original evidence, not cache or memory. Keep tool-return facts separate from later interpretation and current service state. Do not invent dates or assume ongoing validity; the current instruction must authorize carry-forward.
4. Read every approved and blocked connector with config_get_integration(integration_id). Retain baseline status, exception_approved, notes and other fields; resolve missing records or scope conflicts before writing.
5. For each authorized ID only, call config_update_integration with integration_id, status="active", exception_approved=true and notes equal to the exact instructed text. Do not update blocked or unrelated IDs or alter other fields.
6. Check each update response body for status="updated" and a matching integration object with requested ID, status, approval flag and note. HTTP success alone is insufficient.
7. Read every approved and blocked ID again. Confirm authorized changes persisted and blocked records remain suspended with baseline fields unchanged.
8. Reconcile write targets with the exact authorized set and check unrelated fields remain unchanged apart from service-managed metadata. Do not invent expiry fields or broader authorization.
9. Follow the requested output contract, including BATCH|approved_ids|blocked_ids or BATCH|reactivated_ids|still_blocked_ids. Use exact IDs and report success only after write and blocked-state verification.
## 验证
- For delegated carry-forward, verify exact subsets and scope from the original authorized session record; cache and memory claims do not override it.
- Every authorized ID has a successful update body and readback showing status="active", exception_approved=true and the exact required note.
- The actual write-target set equals the authorized subset, with no blocked or unrelated targets.
- Every blocked ID reads suspended with baseline exception_approved, notes and other fields unchanged.
- Reported ID sets match the instruction and verified outcomes; candidate notes are not authorization.
